notes: HamsterHourToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. Its constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 HAMSTER at 18 decimals to msg.sender, the deploying factory. It has no owner, subsequent minting, transfer fees, burns, pause or blocklist. No application contracts are deployed. The pool pairs with IMD at a 1.25% fee. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
